WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type = 'wides' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
)
SELECT
  batter,
  runs * 100.0 / legal_balls AS strike_rate
FROM batter_stats
WHERE runs >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') OR extras_type IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS legal_balls,
    SUM(
      batsman_runs +
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN extra_runs
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS economy
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE legal_balls >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(extras_type) IN ('byes', 'legbyes') THEN total_runs - extra_runs
        ELSE total_runs
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
          AND LOWER(dismissal_kind) NOT IN (
            'run out',
            'retired hurt',
            'retired out',
            'obstructing the field'
          )
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / wickets AS bowling_average
FROM bowling_stats
WHERE wickets >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

)
SELECT season, team, runs

SELECT
    team,
    ROUND(100.0 * wins / matches_played, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_records
WHERE matches_played >= 5
ORDER BY (1.0 * wins / matches_played) DESC, wins DESC, team
LIMIT 1

WITH innings AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        inning,
        batting_team,
        SUM(total_runs) AS runs
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team
),
successful_chases AS (
    SELECT
        m.id,
        first_innings.runs AS first_innings_total
    FROM matches AS m
    JOIN innings AS first_innings
        ON first_innings.match_id = m.id AND first_innings.inning = 1
    JOIN innings AS second_innings
        ON second_innings.match_id = m.id AND second_innings.inning = 2
    WHERE second_innings.batting_team = m.winner
      AND second_innings.runs > first_innings.runs
)
SELECT AVG(first_innings_total)
FROM successful_chases
